items.review_rationale: Read projectivity of a module through exactness of covariant Hom_R(P,−) and the equivalent lifting criterion against every surjective module map, not just a single lifting diagram.

references.context: Functor mapping N to Hom_R(P,N) and morphisms g to post-composition with g.
Every element in N is image of an element of M, required for the lifting test.
For every map P→N and surjection M→N, there exists a map P→M whose composite is original P→N.

references.disposition: A pair of equivalent projectivity criteria; this is not the weaker property of being finitely generated.

items.review_rationale: Read the direct-summand criterion for projective modules as the existence of a complement Q to P inside a possibly infinite free R-module, distinguishing direct sum from quotient or finite freeness.

references.phrase: free module R^(I) on index set I
references.context: Direct sum of copies of R indexed by I with finite support, I not assumed finite.
External direct sum decomposition of R-modules exhibiting P as a direct summand.

references.phrase: free module need not have finite rank
references.disposition: The characterization of arbitrary projectives allows infinite index set I, unlike finite projective modules.
